critical_issues.impact: Stops crawl budget waste; removes brand-damaging results from SERPs
critical_issues.details: helipeople.heliware.co.in/login, helipeople.heliware.co.in/, demo.heliware.co.in/, taxation.heliware.co.in/, heliware.co.in/app/plugin — all require noindex + robots.txt Disallow.

critical_issues.title: HTTP does not redirect to HTTPS on any host
critical_issues.impact: Eliminates mixed-content risk; required for HSTS
critical_issues.details: http://heliware.co.in returns 403, not a 301 redirect to https://. Configure 301 at CDN level for all hosts.
